role: Type reviewer cross-critique; independent initial report retained unchanged

independent_check.method: Instantiated current compiled TTF at wght400/opsz14 with fontTools and recorded lowercase l outline; separately rendered Il1 lilt at16/48/220px with Pillow FreeType and visually inspected via view_image.

correction: Retract initial T01 statement that lowercase l is a plain stem as a factual construction claim. The glyph has a rounded lower turn and right-projecting foot; this is unambiguous in the compiled outline and220px proof. At16px the extension is less than one pixel and visually modest. Limited perceptual prominence is a different claim from absent geometry; no measured confusion rate was established.

arbitration.capital_I: Retain the current bar terminals. Both blind reviewers identify this cue; its diagnostic visibility does not establish a wider line-level personality change.
arbitration.reason: The goal is moderate humanist repeatable style. Existing short l foot, softened joins, familiar a/g choices and compatible RU/EN color can support restrained character. Indistinguishable ordinary A/B lines only limit claims of perceptible improvement in those samples; they do not prove failure against a moderate-character brief or justify mandatory broad reconstruction.
arbitration.recommendation: Keep current constructions for the immediate artifact. Treat stronger l-foot or terminal-family variants as controlled experiments, with repeatable relationships across weights and scripts. Reject immediate global tracking changes or broad glyph redesign solely to make the blind pair look different.
arbitration.acceptance_test: Compare current versus one bounded l-foot/terminal variant in randomized order-swapped unfamiliar RU/EN labels and sentences containing repeated changed forms, at14/16/18px and36/48px, weights100/400/900 with matched opsz. Check outlines for coherent repeated rules and native-size proofs for collisions/counter damage. In a human pilot separately collect I/l/1 transcription errors and repeated style recognition/preference; require a repeatable benefit without new reading or spacing regressions before adopting the variant. Predefine the decision threshold before collecting participant results.

verdict_changes: No overall verdict changes: UI conditional, headings visual pass, body conditional, sustained reading unverified. UI condition now cites potentially weak small-size differentiation, not absent l geometry.
limitations: AI visual assessment, not human participant testing.
Cross-critique is no longer blinded or independent of other reports.
No font or original report edits performed.
